fields.summary: Allow binding on first element (of datatype profiles)
fields.customfield_10618:
We will update the table to indicate that this is allowed.

Will ask the Java and Firely snapshot generator authors to account for this change.

Will create change requests to add invariants asserting all of the 'prohibited' rules in the table so we can make sure that we haven't broken these rules (and possibly update the table if we got things wrong)
fields.description:
From [https://chat.fhir.org/#narrow/channel/179166-implementers/topic/ValueSet.20binding.20on.20CodeableConcept.20in.20datatype.20profile] – it is clear that bindings on the root of datatype profiles are not possible. 

However, this is a valid profiling use case. In our current situation, we have a profile on CodeableConcept datatype that contains a binding. It is used in around 20 host profiles that use this CodeableConcept datatype. Unfortunately, it is not possible to bind the ValueSet only ones but rather, every profile that uses this CodeableConcept datatype profile will need to bind the ValueSet. 

(This datatype profile contains an extension and some documentation so it is still worth it to create the profile...)

The zulip chat contains examples in a zip file.

comments.body:
In addition - should we be surfacing any of the "prohibited" rules as invariants in the StructureDefinition?  Because validators aren't necessarily going to be aware of the content in the table.

Will wait to discuss until we have [~GrahameGrieve] and hopefully [~ewout]

resolution.description: The proposed change will be made in spirit, but with minor adjustments to reflect committee agreement
resolution.name: Persuasive with Modification
